R5.arithmetic: Total length passes (7 x 39 + 6 x 1/8 = 273.75 <= 6 x 72 = 432), but each 72" board yields floor(72 / (39 + 1/8)) = 1 slat since 2 x 39 + 1/8 = 78.125 > 72; 6 boards give 6 slats, 1 short of 7.
R5.reason: The six 72" 2x6 boards cannot supply seven 39" slats. 2x4: four 72" boards for 42, 42, 43, 43 (one piece each, 4 boards) is enough.

R14.arithmetic: (a) Stack of slats = 7 x 5 1/2 + 6 x 1/4 = 38 1/2 + 1 1/2 = 40 in; slat length 39. The frame is 'mitered' (importDiffs source '1 1/2" x 3 1/2" x 42" with 45 degree mitered edges'); if 42 and 43 are the outer long points the opening is 42 - 2 x 3 1/2 = 35 wide and 43 - 7 = 36 tall, so 39 x 40 slats do not fit (4" over each way); if they are the inside lengths the slats (39 of 42, 40 of 43) are 3" short of the sides they must be screwed to.
R14.reason: (a) The slat dimensions do not match the frame opening under either reading of the mitered lengths. (c) The steel rods (and masonry anchoring) used in steps[8] are not in materials (silicone is a consumable). (b) every part installed; (d) steps reach a hung wall.
